deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: Ferriers of souls and keepers of spirit passage are directly associated with death, spirits, memory, and the underworld.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Freyseth
deities.rationale: Their liminal balance and work at boundaries between states place crossings under Freyseth.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Late-life functional wings are interpreted through sky, freedom, and prophetic ascent symbolism.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
